name: PC World Mastercard

apr.notes: Standard rates: 21.99% on purchases; 22.97% on cash advances (21.97% in Quebec).

credit_required.notes: Minimum $50,000 personal or $80,000 household annual income.

base_rate.description: 10 points per $1 (1% back) on dining, transit and everywhere else.

categories.label: Shoppers Drug Mart and Pharmaprix (3.5% back)

rewards.redemption_notes: PC Optimum points redeem instantly in stores and in the app, or to pay down the card balance.

notes: Network tier is World Mastercard per the card name. Earn rates are shown on the page as percent back in PC Optimum points; 10 points per $1 equals 1% back, so rates are recorded as points per $1. Gas earns points per litre at Esso and Mobil stations, which is not a per-dollar rate.
